```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LEGEND NUMBERS — helper
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
LEGEND_FILE <- "SuppFigure2_legend_numbers.txt"
cat("Supplementary Figure 2 - legend numbers\nGenerated: ", format(Sys.time()), "\n",
    file = LEGEND_FILE, sep = "")
legend_out <- function(title, x = NULL) {
  body <- if (is.null(x)) character(0) else if (is.character(x)) x
          else utils::capture.output(print(as.data.frame(x), row.names = FALSE))
  txt <- c("", paste0("=== ", title, " ==="), body)
  cat(txt, sep = "\n"); cat(txt, sep = "\n", file = LEGEND_FILE, append = TRUE)
  invisible(NULL)
}
n_si <- function(df, ..., id = "MM_ID") {
  df %>% dplyr::group_by(...) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_samples = dplyr::n(),
                     n_infants = dplyr::n_distinct(.data[[id]]), .groups = "drop")
}
lmm_term <- function(data, outcome, term,
                     covs = c("Postnatal_Age", "Clean_reads_P1", "DNA_conc")) {
  d <- data[stats::complete.cases(data[, c(outcome, term, covs, "MM_ID")]), , drop = FALSE]
  for (v in covs) d[[paste0(v, "_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(as.numeric(d[[v]])))
  rhs0 <- paste(paste0(covs, "_z"), collapse = " + ")
  m0 <- lmer(stats::as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", rhs0, "+ (1|MM_ID)")), data = d, REML = FALSE)
  m1 <- lmer(stats::as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", rhs0, "+", term, "+ (1|MM_ID)")), data = d, REML = FALSE)
  cf <- summary(m1)$coefficients
  r  <- grep(paste0("^", term), rownames(cf))[1]
  sprintf("n = %d samples / %d infants | effect = %.3f (SE %.3f) | LRT p = %.3g",
          nrow(d), dplyr::n_distinct(d$MM_ID), cf[r, 1], cf[r, 2],
          stats::anova(m1, m0)[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2])
}
# Species names: underscores out, genus abbreviated, for italic axis labels.
pretty_species <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- sub(" sp ", " sp. ", x)
  ifelse(grepl("^[A-Z][a-z]+ sp\\.", x), x, sub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", x))
}
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA — infant samples, probiotic species REMOVED (as in Figures 2 and 3)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
metadata     <- read.delim("metadata_cleaned_april.txt")
taxa_cleaned <- read.delim("taxa_cleaned_jan.txt")
row.names(taxa_cleaned) <- taxa_cleaned$ID; taxa_cleaned$ID <- NULL
row.names(metadata) <- metadata$ID

metadata_infant <- metadata[grep("^B", rownames(metadata)), ]
taxa_infant     <- taxa_cleaned[grep("^B", rownames(taxa_cleaned)), ]

factor_vars <- c("prolonged_rupt", "surgery", "ab48", "multiple", "delivery_md",
                 "maternal_atb", "mother_st_com", "placenta_ab", "pe_hellp",
                 "maternal_infect", "mother_b_hem", "nec", "sex", "sip",
                 "sepsis_culture", "pda_sign", "mortality", "pda", "probiotics",
                 "SGA", "LGA", "FGR", "ivh", "abtx")
numeric_vars <- c("mmpercentage", "probiotic_sample", "apgar_1", "apgar_5",
                  "antibiotic_sample", "ga_exact", "bw", "admissiontime", "tpn_days",
                  "TFEF_B", "TFEF", "DNA_conc", "Clean_reads_P1", "week",
                  "Postnatal_Age", "MM_ID")
metadata_infant[factor_vars]  <- lapply(metadata_infant[factor_vars], as.factor)
metadata_infant[numeric_vars] <- lapply(metadata_infant[numeric_vars], as.numeric)

taxa <- taxa_infant[row.names(taxa_infant) %in% rownames(metadata_infant), ]
taxa_sp <- taxa[, grep("s__", colnames(taxa))]
taxa_sp <- taxa_sp[, -grep("t__", colnames(taxa_sp))]
colnames(taxa_sp) <- gsub(".*s__", "", colnames(taxa_sp))

PROBIOTIC_SPECIES <- c("Bifidobacterium_longum", "Bifidobacterium_animalis",
                       "Streptococcus_thermophilus")
legend_out("Probiotic species removed before diversity and composition analyses",
           data.frame(species = PROBIOTIC_SPECIES,
                      present_in_table = PROBIOTIC_SPECIES %in% colnames(taxa_sp)))
taxa_sp <- taxa_sp[, !colnames(taxa_sp) %in% PROBIOTIC_SPECIES, drop = FALSE]
taxa_sp <- taxa_sp %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(.)))

richness <- plyr::ddply(taxa_sp, ~ rownames(taxa_sp),
                        function(x) data.frame(RICHNESS = sum(x[-1] > 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
row.names(richness) <- richness$`rownames(taxa_sp)`; richness$`rownames(taxa_sp)` <- NULL
my_alpha_diversity <- data.frame(Shannon = diversity(taxa_sp, index = "shannon"),
                                 Simpson = diversity(taxa_sp, index = "simpson"))
my_alpha_diversity <- merge(my_alpha_diversity, richness, by = "row.names")
row.names(my_alpha_diversity) <- my_alpha_diversity$Row.names
my_alpha_diversity$Row.names <- NULL

phenos_imputed_div <- merge(my_alpha_diversity, metadata_infant, by = "row.names")
row.names(phenos_imputed_div) <- phenos_imputed_div$Row.names
phenos_imputed_div$Row.names <- NULL
phenos_imputed_div$week <- factor(as.character(phenos_imputed_div$week),
                                  levels = as.character(1:8), labels = paste0("W", 1:8))
phenos_imputed_div$probiotics <- factor(as.character(phenos_imputed_div$probiotics),
                                        levels = c("0", "1"), labels = c("No", "Yes"))

legend_out("Supp 2 — analysed infant samples", phenos_imputed_div %>% n_si())
legend_out("Supp 2 — samples / infants by probiotic exposure at sampling",
           phenos_imputed_div %>% n_si(probiotics))
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# a — Shannon diversity by postnatal week, stratified by probiotic exposure
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
plot_a <- phenos_imputed_div %>% filter(!is.na(Shannon), !is.na(probiotics), !is.na(week))

stats_a <- purrr::map_dfr(levels(plot_a$week), function(w) {
  d <- plot_a[plot_a$week == w, ]
  g <- droplevels(d$probiotics); n <- table(g)
  if (nlevels(g) < 2 || any(n < 3))
    return(tibble(week = w, n_no = unname(n["No"]), n_yes = unname(n["Yes"]),
                  p_value = NA_real_))
  tibble(week = w, n_no = sum(g == "No"), n_yes = sum(g == "Yes"),
         p_value = suppressWarnings(
           stats::wilcox.test(d$Shannon ~ g, exact = FALSE)$p.value))
})
ok <- !is.na(stats_a$p_value)
stats_a$p_adj <- NA_real_
stats_a$p_adj[ok] <- stats::p.adjust(stats_a$p_value[ok], method = "BH")
stats_a$significance <- cut(stats_a$p_adj, c(-Inf, .001, .01, .05, Inf),
                            labels = c("***", "**", "*", ""), right = FALSE)
stats_a <- left_join(stats_a,
  plot_a %>% group_by(week) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(label_y = max(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.2, .groups = "drop"),
  by = "week")

p_a <- ggplot(plot_a, aes(week, Shannon, fill = probiotics, color = probiotics)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, outlier.colour = NA, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.3,
                                                          jitter.height = 0,
                                                          dodge.width = 0.8)) +
  geom_text(data = subset(stats_a, !is.na(significance) & significance != ""),
            aes(x = week, y = label_y, label = significance),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(No = "#4a3aa7", Yes = "#1baf7a")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(No = "#4a3aa7", Yes = "#1baf7a")) +
  labs(x = "Postnatal week", y = "Shannon diversity index",
       fill = "Probiotics", color = "Probiotics") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 60, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
print(p_a)
ggsave("S2a_shannon_probiotics_week.pdf", p_a, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

legend_out("Supp 2a — samples / infants per week and probiotic exposure",
           plot_a %>% n_si(week, probiotics))
legend_out("Supp 2a — per-week Wilcoxon (two-sided), BH across weeks tested",
           stats_a %>% transmute(week, n_no, n_yes,
                                 p_value = signif(p_value, 3), p_adj = signif(p_adj, 3)))
legend_out("Supp 2a — overall LMM: Shannon ~ probiotics + age + reads + DNA conc + (1|infant)",
           lmm_term(plot_a, "Shannon", "probiotics"))
legend_out("Supp 2a — note",
           "Shannon is computed AFTER removing the three probiotic species, so this is diversity of the remaining community.")
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# b — species associated with probiotic exposure (probiotic species excluded)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Reads the mixed-model screen produced by the Mixed Models notebook
# (taxa_sp_mixed_all_nopbtx.txt): CLR abundance ~ sequencing depth +
# DNA concentration + postnatal age + phenotype + (1|infant), likelihood-ratio
# tests, BH correction across all species x phenotype tests in that file.
MODEL_FILE <- "taxa_sp_mixed_all_nopbtx.txt"

taxa_sp_mixed <- read.delim(MODEL_FILE)

pbtx_results <- taxa_sp_mixed %>%
  filter(Pheno == "probiotics", FDR < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(Bug) %>% slice_min(order_by = FDR, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(label = pretty_species(Bug),
         label = factor(label, levels = label[order(t.value)]),
         direction = factor(ifelse(t.value > 0, "More", "Less"),
                            levels = c("Less", "More")))

p_b <- ggplot(pbtx_results, aes(label, t.value, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(colour = "black", width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = alpha(c(Less = "#4a3aa7", More = "#1baf7a"), 0.9),
                    labels = c(Less = "", More = "")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Increased with probiotic exposure")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "t-value") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
print(p_b)
ggsave("S2b_species_probiotics.pdf", p_b, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)

legend_out("Supp 2b — model file",
           sprintf("%s | phenotypes: %d | species: %d | unique species x phenotype tests: %d | species tested for probiotics: %d",
                   MODEL_FILE, dplyr::n_distinct(taxa_sp_mixed$Pheno),
                   dplyr::n_distinct(taxa_sp_mixed$Bug),
                   nrow(dplyr::distinct(taxa_sp_mixed, Bug, Pheno)),
                   sum(taxa_sp_mixed$Pheno == "probiotics")))
legend_out("Supp 2b — plotted species (FDR < 0.05); positive t = higher with probiotics",
           pbtx_results %>% transmute(Bug, t.value = round(t.value, 2),
                                      P = signif(P, 3), FDR = signif(FDR, 3)) %>%
             arrange(desc(t.value)))
legend_out("Supp 2b — counts",
           sprintf("species shown: %d (%d higher, %d lower with probiotic exposure)",
                   nrow(pbtx_results), sum(pbtx_results$t.value > 0),
                   sum(pbtx_results$t.value < 0)))
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# c — bacterial composition of the probiotic sachets
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# The sequenced product samples (SampleType == "probiotic"; P300_00_13H1/H2).
# Relative abundances straight from MetaPhlAn, no filtering or transformation.
MIN_PCT <- 0.1   # species below this in every sachet are pooled into "Other"

prod_ids <- metadata$ID[trimws(as.character(metadata$SampleType)) == "probiotic"]
prod_ids <- intersect(prod_ids, rownames(taxa_cleaned))
stopifnot(length(prod_ids) > 0)

sp_all <- taxa_cleaned[, grep("s__", colnames(taxa_cleaned)), drop = FALSE]
sp_all <- sp_all[, !grepl("t__", colnames(sp_all)), drop = FALSE]
colnames(sp_all) <- gsub(".*s__", "", colnames(sp_all))
prod <- sp_all[prod_ids, , drop = FALSE] %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

legend_out("Supp 2c — sequenced probiotic product samples",
           sprintf("n = %d samples: %s", length(prod_ids), paste(prod_ids, collapse = ", ")))

prod_long <- prod %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "Species", values_to = "pct") %>%
  filter(pct > 0)

keep_sp <- prod_long %>% group_by(Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(max_pct = max(pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(max_pct >= MIN_PCT) %>% pull(Species)

prod_plot <- prod_long %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species %in% keep_sp, Species, "Other (<0.1%)")) %>%
  group_by(sample, Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(pct = sum(pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(Species == "Other (<0.1%)", Species, pretty_species(Species)))

sp_order <- prod_plot %>% group_by(label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(m = mean(pct), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(m)) %>% pull(label)
sp_order <- c(setdiff(sp_order, "Other (<0.1%)"), intersect(sp_order, "Other (<0.1%)"))
prod_plot$label <- factor(prod_plot$label, levels = rev(sp_order))

p_c <- ggplot(prod_plot, aes(sample, pct, fill = label)) +
  geom_col(colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = NULL, option = "D", direction = -1) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance (%)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10),
        legend.position = "right",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11))
print(p_c)
ggsave("S2c_probiotic_product_composition.pdf", p_c, width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

legend_out("Supp 2c — composition per sachet (% relative abundance, species > 0)",
           prod_long %>% mutate(pct = round(pct, 3)) %>%
             arrange(sample, desc(pct)) %>%
             dplyr::rename(relative_abundance_pct = pct))
legend_out("Supp 2c — species detected per sachet",
           prod_long %>% group_by(sample) %>%
             dplyr::summarise(n_species = dplyr::n(),
                              top_species = Species[which.max(pct)],
                              top_pct = round(max(pct), 2), .groups = "drop"))
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# d — maternal gut microbiome: PCoA of Aitchison distances by delivery mode
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Maternal samples only; one sample per mother, so no repeated-measures term.
PREV_MIN_MOTHERS <- 5      # species detected above 0.01% in >= this many mothers
PREV_ABUNDANCE   <- 0.01
DELIVERY_COLS    <- c(Vaginal = "#ff7f0e", Caesarean = "#1f77b4")

meta_m <- metadata %>% filter(trimws(as.character(SampleType)) == "maternal")
rownames(meta_m) <- meta_m$ID

sp_m <- sp_all[intersect(rownames(meta_m), rownames(sp_all)), , drop = FALSE] %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
meta_m <- meta_m[rownames(sp_m), , drop = FALSE]

meta_m$delivery <- factor(as.character(meta_m$delivery_md), levels = c("0", "1"),
                          labels = c("Vaginal", "Caesarean"))
meta_m <- meta_m[!is.na(meta_m$delivery), , drop = FALSE]
sp_m   <- sp_m[rownames(meta_m), , drop = FALSE]
for (v in c("Clean_reads_P1", "DNA_conc", "Sample_birth"))
  if (v %in% colnames(meta_m)) meta_m[[v]] <- as.numeric(as.character(meta_m[[v]]))

detected <- colSums(sp_m > PREV_ABUNDANCE, na.rm = TRUE)
sp_m_keep <- sp_m[, detected >= PREV_MIN_MOTHERS, drop = FALSE]
pseudo_m  <- min(sp_m_keep[sp_m_keep != 0]) / 2
dist_m    <- vegdist(sp_m_keep, method = "aitchison", pseudocount = pseudo_m)

pcoa_m <- cmdscale(dist_m, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
var_m  <- round(pcoa_m$eig * 100 / sum(pcoa_m$eig), 2)
pcoa_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa_m$points) %>% setNames(c("PC1", "PC2")) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(".sample") %>%
  left_join(tibble(.sample = rownames(meta_m), delivery = meta_m$delivery),
            by = ".sample")

p_d <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = delivery, fill = delivery)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = delivery), type = "t", linetype = 2, geom = "path",
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Delivery mode", values = DELIVERY_COLS) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Delivery mode", values = DELIVERY_COLS) +
  labs(x = paste0("PCo1 = ", var_m[1], "%"), y = paste0("PCo2 = ", var_m[2], "%")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid = element_blank())

p_d <- ggExtra::ggMarginal(p_d, type = "histogram", groupColour = FALSE,
                           groupFill = TRUE,
                           xparams = list(bins = 40, alpha = 0.8,
                                          position = "identity", color = "white"),
                           yparams = list(bins = 40, alpha = 0.8,
                                          position = "identity", color = "white"))
print(p_d)
ggsave("S2d_maternal_PCoA_delivery.pdf", p_d, width = 5.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# PERMANOVA, unadjusted and adjusted for the technical covariates
covs_m <- intersect(c("Clean_reads_P1", "DNA_conc"), colnames(meta_m))
fit_perm <- function(covs, label) {
  keep <- stats::complete.cases(meta_m[, c("delivery", covs), drop = FALSE])
  d <- meta_m[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  dm <- as.dist(as.matrix(dist_m)[rownames(d), rownames(d)])
  set.seed(42)
  ad <- adonis2(stats::as.formula(paste("dm ~", paste(c(covs, "delivery"), collapse = " + "))),
                data = d, permutations = 10000, by = "margin")
  sprintf("%s: n = %d mothers | R2 = %.4f | F = %.2f | p = %.3g",
          label, nrow(d), ad["delivery", "R2"], ad["delivery", "F"],
          ad["delivery", "Pr(>F)"])
}
legend_out("Supp 2d — maternal samples by delivery mode",
           meta_m %>% dplyr::count(delivery, name = "n_mothers"))
legend_out("Supp 2d — PERMANOVA, delivery mode (10,000 permutations, marginal SS)",
           c(fit_perm(character(0), "unadjusted"),
             fit_perm(covs_m, "+ sequencing depth + DNA concentration")))
legend_out("Supp 2d — species in the maternal distance",
           sprintf("%d of %d species (detected above %.2f%% in >= %d mothers) | PCo1 %.2f%%, PCo2 %.2f%%",
                   ncol(sp_m_keep), ncol(sp_m), PREV_ABUNDANCE, PREV_MIN_MOTHERS,
                   var_m[1], var_m[2]))

# PERMANOVA cannot separate a shift in location from a difference in spread, so
# the dispersion test is reported alongside it.
bd <- betadisper(dist_m, meta_m$delivery)
set.seed(42)
bd_p <- permutest(bd, permutations = 10000)$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"]
legend_out("Supp 2d — multivariate dispersion (betadisper / PERMDISP)",
           sprintf("p = %.3g | mean distance to centroid: vaginal %.2f, caesarean %.2f",
                   bd_p, mean(bd$distances[meta_m$delivery == "Vaginal"]),
                   mean(bd$distances[meta_m$delivery == "Caesarean"])))

cat("\n✓ Saved: S2a-S2d PDFs and ", LEGEND_FILE, "\n", sep = "")
sessionInfo()
```
